exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to the post of Scientist 'B' (Group 'A' Gazetted) in National Informatics Centre (NIC) and attached scientific organizations under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) is administered by the National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT). The selection process consists of a Written Examination followed by a Personal Interview. The Written Examination is an objective OMR-based or Computer Based Test of 180 minutes (3 hours) duration containing 120 multiple-choice questions (120 marks), divided into Generic (35%) and Technical (65%) sections. Candidates securing minimum 50% for General/EWS (40% for OBC, 30% for SC/ST/PWD) are shortlisted for interview in the ratio of 1:3 per vacancy. The final merit list is prepared giving 85% weightage to the Written Examination and 15% weightage to the Interview.

financial_package.note: Scientist 'B' is a central Group 'A' Gazetted scientific appointment under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). Officers are placed in Pay Level 10 of the central 7th CPC Pay Matrix (entry basic pay ₹56,100 per month) and are eligible for time-bound promotions under the Flexible Complementing Scheme (FCS), standard central allowances, and technical updates.
financial_package.pay_source_label: NIELIT Notification — Pay Matrix Level 10 (₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500) for Scientist 'B'
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 10 basic pay of ₹56,100 + 58% DA (₹32,538) + HRA ranging from 10% (Z city, ₹5,610) to 30% (X metro city / Delhi HQ, ₹16,830) + Transport Allowance (₹7,200 + 58% DA = ₹11,376 in higher TPTA cities). In-hand estimate factors in 10% NPS deduction (₹8,864) and standard professional and income taxes.
official_perks: Flexible Complementing Scheme (FCS) enabling time-bound in-situ merit promotions from Scientist 'B' up to Scientist 'G'
Central Government HRA (30%/20%/10% by city category) or allotment of General Pool Residential Accommodation (GPRA)
Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) offering comprehensive cashless medical treatment for officer and family dependents
Annual Professional Development / Book Allowance for technical literature, international journals, and conferences
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% monthly employer contribution by Government of India
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) entitlements
